title: BaultFrame Module Manifest
description: Schema for module.json — the manifest file for a BaultFrame module.

name.description: PascalCase module name, e.g. 'User', 'Cms'. Must match the Modules/<Name> directory.

alias.description: Short kebab-case or lowercase alias, e.g. 'user', 'cms'.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the module does.

enabled.description: Whether the module is loaded by the framework at boot time.

api_version.description: Manifest schema version. Use 2 for current format; 1 is legacy.

min_core_version.description: Minimum BaultFrame core version required by this module.

capabilities.description: Capabilities (features) provided by this module. Other modules can depend on these strings instead of concrete class names.

permissions.description: System resources this module needs. Format: '<resource>:<action>', e.g. 'cache:read', 'storage:write'. Used for future sandboxing and permission checks.

hooks.description: Fully qualified class name (FQCN) of a class implementing Core\Module\ModuleLifecycle. Called during install / enable / disable / uninstall lifecycle transitions.

providers.description: List of service provider FQCNs to register when the module is enabled.

require.description: Composer package dependencies, in the same format as composer.json 'require'. These are installed automatically when the module is installed.

signature.description: Optional SHA-256 content hash used to verify module integrity (stored in the HASH file).

activate.description: When to load this module: on_boot (default), on_request (lazy when path matches route_prefix(es)), on_first_use (reserved).

route_prefix.description: Single path prefix that triggers loading when activate=on_request. If set, route_prefixes is ignored.

route_prefixes.description: Path prefixes that trigger loading when activate=on_request. Longest match wins.

file.description: Legacy field. Reserved for future use.
